tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide background for every layout. Site token --at-bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels that sit on `surface`: quiz options, exercise box, figure frame, output panel of the runner. Adapted: the site uses translucent glass (--at-bg-panel); slides use the solid colour so projectors do not wash it out.

tokens.name: surface-chip
tokens.usage: Inline code background and neutral chips, on `surface` or `surface-raised`. Site token --at-bg-chip.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only separate (footer rule, table rows). Decorative: never the only boundary of something the class must see. Site token --at-border.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of `surface-raised` panels and quiz options, column divider in two-columns. Site token --at-border-strong.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Slide titles when not gradient, the quiz question, numbers in a fact. On `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text: lists, lead lines, labels. On `surface` (14.3:1 light, 15.7:1 dark) and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running prose and callout bodies. On `surface`, `surface-raised` and every `callout-*-bg` (≥8.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, quote attribution, footer text, slide number. On `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥5:1 both themes). Site value darkened for WCAG 1.4.3.

tokens.name: ink-muted-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text that must stay readable: subtitle on the cover, tagline under section titles. On `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only (fails 4.5:1): disabled step dots, ghost line numbers. Never for words the class must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand accent: kicker text when no volume is set, links, focus ring, the runner's Run button fill. Text on `surface` 5.1:1 light / 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent text on accent tints (`accent-tint`): chips, the active step label.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of accent chips and the highlighted line in step-by-step code.

tokens.name: accent-tint-border
tokens.usage: Border of accent chips.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (Run button). 5.4:1 light, 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus in presenter and runner UI: 2px solid ring with 2px offset in `surface`. Alias of `accent`, ≥3:1 on both surfaces.

tokens.name: grad-1
tokens.usage: First stop of the Atmospheric gradient (135deg, grad-1 → grad-2 → grad-3). Only on cover, section and end titles, never on content slides.

tokens.name: grad-2
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the Atmospheric gradient.

tokens.name: grad-3
tokens.usage: Last stop of the Atmospheric gradient.

tokens.name: vol-programmatore
tokens.usage: Volume 1 · Manuale del Programmatore: marks only — volume icon, the 4px rule under the kicker, progress dots, the cover block. ≥3:1 on `surface` (graphics), not for text in light. Site: ChapterIndex --vc.

tokens.name: vol-programmatore-ink
tokens.usage: Volume 1 · Manuale del Programmatore: text in the volume colour — kicker, chip label, section number. ≥4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `vol-programmatore-tint` in both themes. Site: VolumeCard kicker colour.

tokens.name: vol-programmatore-tint
tokens.usage: Volume 1 · Manuale del Programmatore: background of the volume chip and of the cover icon tile.

tokens.name: vol-programmatore-beam-1
tokens.usage: Volume 1 · Manuale del Programmatore: gradient stop 1 for the cover/section/end glow when this volume is active (replaces grad-1). Site: VolumeCard --vol-beam-1.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background (Shiki/Monaco). Light from GitHub, dark from Dracula, as the site's Prism themes.

tokens.name: code-fg
tokens.usage: Identifiers, operators and default code text on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Python keywords and builtin function names on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: String literals on `code-bg`. Adapted from the site's #e3116c (4.3:1) to reach 5.5:1 when projected.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numeric literals on `code-bg`. Adapted from the site's #36acaa (2.6:1) light; dark follows Dracula purple instead of the site's #f8f8f2 so numbers stand out.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments (set in Monaspace Radon) on `code-bg`. Adapted from the site's #998877 / #6272a4 (3.2:1 / 3.0:1) to ≥4.6:1 for projection.

tokens.name: code-line-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of the highlighted lines in step-by-step code; the other lines drop to 45% opacity.

tokens.name: answer-correct
tokens.usage: Revealed correct option in a quiz: border, check icon and the word “Corretta”. Teal (hue 175) so it never pairs with `answer-wrong` on the red–green axis alone; always with the icon and word.

tokens.name: answer-correct-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the revealed correct option.

tokens.name: answer-wrong
tokens.usage: A wrong option the teacher marks: border, cross icon and the word “Sbagliata”. Always with the icon and word.

tokens.name: answer-wrong-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a marked wrong option.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and end title, gradient fill. One or two lines.

styles.name: fact
styles.usage: The single number or short phrase of a fact slide (≤ 12 characters).

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: h1 of every content slide, in `ink-strong`. One line; two at most.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Una tupla è una sequenza che non cambia.
styles.usage: The one-sentence claim under a title, definition body, quiz question text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Le parentesi tonde creano la tupla.
styles.usage: Lists and prose on content slides. Never smaller on a slide meant to be read from the back row.

styles.name: callout-body
styles.sample: Una tupla con un solo elemento vuole la virgola.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figura 1 — Due nomi, un solo oggetto.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks on slides: ≤ 14 lines at this size. Ligatures off, texture healing on (calt).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: UPPERCASE eyebrow above titles («Volume 3 · Capitolo 02», «Esercizio», «Domanda»), in `vol-*-ink` or `accent`.

styles.name: chrome
styles.usage: Footer: volume, chapter, slide number, licence, URL. `ink-muted`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Runner toolbar buttons and option letters in quizzes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between kicker and title; list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Callout header gap; quiz option inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Callout and panel vertical padding; gap between stacked callouts.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Callout horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between title block and content; column gutter half.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Footer height; gap between quiz options rows.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Slide top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Two-columns gutter; vertical gap before a big code block.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Slide horizontal padding (left/right safe margin).

radius.note: Site scale, 4px steps: the step equals the typical padding, so nested corners stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inline code, option letters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Callouts, buttons, runner output.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, quiz options, figure frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cover icon tile, exercise panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Volume chip, step dots.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Logo in the footer and on the cover.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Code blocks, quiz options, exercise panel, figure frame.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: The cover icon tile; a revealed answer. At most one per slide.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Slidev canvasWidth.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: 980 / (16/9), rounded as Slidev does.

tokens.name: footer-height
tokens.usage: Footer band at the bottom of content slides.

tokens.name: logo-footer
tokens.usage: Logo size in the footer.

tokens.name: logo-cover
tokens.usage: Logo size on cover and end.

tokens.name: dim-lines
tokens.usage: Opacity of non-highlighted lines in step-by-step code.

tokens.name: glow-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the radial glow on cover/section/end in light (site --at-stage-opacity); dark uses 1.
